description: This file contains a Go package 'v2' with functions for converting internal OpenAPI v3 schemas to v2 schemas, including schema modifications and filtering functions.

methods.name: ToStructuralOpenAPIV2
methods.description: Converts an internal OpenAPI v3 structural schema to a v2 compatible schema by removing unsupported fields and adjusting properties.

methods.name: filterOut
methods.description: Filters out a specific string from a slice of strings, used to modify required fields in schemas.
